articles.summary: SFT followed by GRPO is the standard post-training recipe for reasoning models. You collect labeled data, fine-tune, then run reinforcement learning with a reward signal. But there's a design decision that's unexplored: how much of your GRPO data should overlap with your SFT data?
articles.title: Testing Data Overlap Between SFT and GRPO on Autoformalization

articles.summary: In order to train large MoE models with RL, you need two systems: a training cluster and an inference cluster. Our stack pairs Megatron-LM with SGLang for this purpose. We wanted to share the process of how we added support for LoRA within our training stack - specifically for the Qwen3.5 MoE models.
articles.title: Unlocking LoRA MoE RL for Qwen3.5
